abilities.name: Essence Collection
abilities.description: Heal Dehaka for 29 Health per stored Essence over 5 seconds. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow. passive Gain 10 Essence from Takedowns and 2 Essence from nearby Minions dying. Maximum of 50 Essence.; 1; D

abilities.name: Drag
abilities.description: Dehaka lashes out his tongue, dealing 160 damage to the first enemy hit, Stunning and dragging them with him for 1.75 seconds. If Dehaka is Stunned or Silenced while using Drag, the effect ends.

fields.notes: Is also interrupted by Daze (from Knockbacks). Can use Basic Attacks and all other Abilities except Burrow without interrupting Drag.

abilities.name: Dark Swarm
abilities.description: Deal 48 damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for 3.5 seconds. While active, you are able to move through units. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.description: Burrow into the ground, entering Stasis and becoming Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While Burrowed, Dehaka can move at 50% Movement Speed.; 20 / 0.5

fields.notes: Burrow can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early. Temporarily disables all Movement Speed buffs while active, causing Dehaka to always move at 50% speed while Burrowed. Will not remove Revealed status.

abilities.name: Isolation
abilities.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.; 60; 70; Heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crows control, Status effect, Vision reduction
fields.props: Channeled cast (stationary), Revealed, Silence, Skillshot, Slow
fields.notes: Interrupting the ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Enemy Heroes hit by Isolation are Revealed for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Adaptation
abilities.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.; 60; 70; Heroic

fields.notes: Healing is calculated from final damage taken, after damage modifications. Amount healed can further be affected by healing modifiers affecting either Dehaka's healing output (e.g. Spell Power) or healing received.

abilities.name: Brushstalker
abilities.description: Activate to burrow to a bush on the Battleground. Passive Gain 20% Movement Speed while in a bush and for 2 seconds after leaving.

fields.notes: Interrupting Brushstalker during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown. While traveling, Dehaka is removed from battleground and put in Stasis for 1.5 seconds, removing most debuffs. Targeting Brushstalker inside of Dehaka's unit radius (or self-casting it) causes Dehaka to use it in place and its cooldown to be reset when he emerges.

talents.name: Enduring Swarm
talents.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

talents.name: Tissue Regeneration
talents.description: Regneration Globes grant 10 Essence. Repeatable Quest Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

fields.notes: Essence collected while at maximum Essence still counts toward quest progress.

_raw_fields: Regneration Globes grant 10 Essence. Repeatable Quest Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

talents.name: Enhanced Agility
talents.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush. Repeatable Quest Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself and Brushstalker 's passive Movement Speed bonus. Essence collected while at maximum Essence still counts toward quest progress.
